```{r Setup}
# ====================================================================
# SETUP AND DATA PREP
# ====================================================================
packages <- c("igraph", "lsa", "dplyr", "Matrix", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "dplyr")
new_packages <- packages[!(packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if (length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```


```{r MONTE CARLO}
NEA <- read.csv("cleanData.csv")
target_vars <- c("pl_radj", "pl_bmassj", "pl_orbper", "pl_orbeccen", "pl_insol", "pl_dens")
NEA <- NEA[complete.cases(NEA[, target_vars]), ]

calc_flags <- c(
  "<a refstr=CALCULATED_VALUE href=/docs/composite_calc.html target=_blank>Calculated Value</a>",
  "<a refstr=CALCULATED_VALUE href=/docs/pscp_calc.html target=_blank>Calculated Value</a>"
)
NEA <- NEA[!(NEA$pl_radj_reflink %in% calc_flags), ]
NEA <- NEA[!(NEA$pl_bmassj_reflink %in% calc_flags), ]

# ====================================================================
# MONTE CARLO SIMULATION INITIALIZATION
# ====================================================================
num_runs <- 100
threshold_value <- 0.97
log_vars <- c("pl_orbper", "pl_bmassj", "pl_radj", "pl_insol", "pl_dens")

# Arrays to store global metrics
communities_count <- numeric(num_runs)

# List to store the cluster medians from every run
mc_results_list <- list()

print(paste("Starting", num_runs, "Monte Carlo iterations..."))

# ====================================================================
# MONTE CARLO LOOP
# ====================================================================

for (i in 1:num_runs) {
  
  # 1. Sub-sample 90% of the dataset to induce variance
  #sample_idx <- sample(nrow(NEA), size = floor(0.9 * nrow(NEA)), replace = FALSE)
  #NEA_sim <- NEA[sample_idx, ]
  
  # Use 100% OF THE DATA
  NEA_sim <- NEA
  
  # 2. Prepare and Log-Transform
  selected_columns_logged <- NEA_sim[, target_vars]
  valid_log_vars <- intersect(log_vars, colnames(selected_columns_logged))
  
  for (v in valid_log_vars) {
    selected_columns_logged[[v]] <- log10(selected_columns_logged[[v]])
  }
  
  # 3. Min-Max Scaling
  normalized_columns <- apply(selected_columns_logged, 2, function(x) {
    (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  
  TRMOE_NEA <- t(normalized_columns)
  colnames(TRMOE_NEA) <- NEA_sim$pl_name
  
  # 4. Cosine Similarity & Thresholding
  cosine_matrix <- lsa::cosine(as.matrix(TRMOE_NEA))
  cosine_matrix[cosine_matrix < threshold_value] <- 0
  diag(cosine_matrix) <- 0
  
  # 5. Build Network & Clean Isolates
  cosine_sparse <- Matrix::Matrix(cosine_matrix, sparse = TRUE)
  cosine_net <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(cosine_sparse, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
  
  isolated <- which(degree(cosine_net) == 0)
  cosine_net_clean <- delete_vertices(cosine_net, isolated)
  undirected_net <- simplify(cosine_net_clean)
  
  # 6. Run Louvain
  Louvain_Comm <- cluster_louvain(undirected_net)
  communities_count[i] <- length(Louvain_Comm)
  
  # 7. Create Assignments & Merge Back
  cluster_assignments <- data.frame(
    pl_name = V(undirected_net)$name,
    Cluster = as.character(Louvain_Comm$membership)
  )
  NEA_clustered <- merge(NEA_sim, cluster_assignments, by = "pl_name")
  
  # 8.1 Calculate MEDIANS for each in this run
  # run_summary <- NEA_clustered %>%
  #   dplyr::group_by(Cluster) %>%
  #   dplyr::summarize(
  #     Run_ID = i, # Tag the run number
  #     Count = dplyr::n(),
      # Med_Mass = median(pl_bmassj, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Med_Radius = median(pl_radj, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Med_Period = median(pl_orbper, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Med_Eccen = median(pl_orbeccen, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Med_Insol = median(pl_insol, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Med_Dens = median(pl_dens, na.rm = TRUE),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   )
  
  # 8.2 Calculate MEANS for each cluster in this run
  run_summary <- NEA_clustered %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      Run_ID = i, # Tag the run number
      Count = dplyr::n(),
      Mean_Mass = mean(pl_bmassj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Radius = mean(pl_radj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Period = mean(pl_orbper, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Eccen = mean(pl_orbeccen, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Insol = mean(pl_insol, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_Dens = mean(pl_dens, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Mass = median(pl_bmassj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Radius = median(pl_radj, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Period = median(pl_orbper, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Eccen = median(pl_orbeccen, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Insol = median(pl_insol, na.rm = TRUE),
      Med_Dens = median(pl_dens, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Save this run's cluster table into our master list
  mc_results_list[[i]] <- run_summary
  
  if (i %% 10 == 0) {
    print(paste("Completed run", i, "of", num_runs))
  }
}


# ====================================================================
# AGGREGATE RESULTS
# ====================================================================
# Bind all 100 runs into one master dataframe
MC_Master_Data <- dplyr::bind_rows(mc_results_list)

# Switches Run_ID and cluster
MC_Master_Data <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::select(Run_ID, Cluster, dplyr::everything())

print("==================================================")
print("          MONTE CARLO SIMULATION COMPLETE         ")
print("==================================================")
print(paste("Average Communities Found per Run:", round(mean(communities_count), 2)))
print("Preview of your per-cluster data across runs:")
print(head(MC_Master_Data))
write.csv(MC_Master_Data, "Monte_Carlo_Cluster_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Number of Communities versus Run ID
```{r Graph 1}
plot(table(MC_Master_Data$Run_ID), type = "o", col = "blue", xlab = "Run ID", ylab = "Communities Detected", main = "Network Stability")
```

# Organizing the clusters so each cluster in each run lines up
```{r Organize}
MC_Master_Data <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    True_Cluster = dplyr::case_when(
      # 1. If Louvain originally called it Cluster 4, lock it in as Cluster 4
      Cluster == 4 | Cluster == "4" ~ "Cluster 4",
      
      # 2. Otherwise, apply our physical thresholds to fix the label switching
      Mean_Radius < 0.5 ~ "1_SubNeptunes_SuperEarths",
      Mean_Eccen > 0.2 ~ "3_Eccentric_Giants",
      Mean_Radius > 1.0 & Mean_Eccen < 0.1 ~ "2_Hot_Jupiters",
      
      # 3. Catch-all just in case anything slips through
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified" 
    )
  )

# Print the results to the console
cluster_verification <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::count(True_Cluster, name = "Total_Occurrences")
print("--- Verification of True Cluster Assignments ---")
print(cluster_verification)
```

# Cluster 1 ALL runs data
```{r}
# 1. Filter out only the First True Cluster
cluster1_data <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::filter(True_Cluster == "1_SubNeptunes_SuperEarths")

# 2. Reshape the data so ggplot can easily make a 3x2 grid
cluster1_long <- cluster1_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Med_Mass, Med_Radius, Med_Period, Med_Eccen, Med_Insol, Med_Dens),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Med_Value"
  )

# 3. Calculate the overall average for each variable (for the RED dotted line)
averages_data <- cluster1_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(Total_Avg = mean(Med_Value, na.rm = TRUE))

# 4. Build the faceted plot
dashboard_plot <- ggplot(cluster1_long, aes(x = Run_ID, y = Med_Value)) +
  geom_line(color = "#75460E", alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_point(color = "#75460E", size = 1.5) +
  # Add the RED dotted line using the averages we just calculated
  geom_hline(data = averages_data, aes(yintercept = Total_Avg), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
  # facet_wrap builds the 3x2 grid (ncol = 2 means 2 columns, so 3 rows)
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) + 
  labs(
    title = "Cluster 1 (Sub-Neptunes) Stability Across 100 Runs",
    x = "Run ID",
    y = "Median Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + # A clean theme with borders around each plot
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# 5. Display the plot
print(dashboard_plot)
```

# Master Summary Table
```{r}
master_summary_table <- MC_Master_Data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(True_Cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    Avg_Count      = round(mean(Count, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    Avg_Med_Mass   = round(mean(Med_Mass, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Radius = round(mean(Med_Radius, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Period = round(mean(Med_Period, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Avg_Med_Eccen  = round(mean(Med_Eccen, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Avg_Med_Insol  = round(mean(Med_Insol, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Avg_Med_Dens   = round(mean(Med_Dens, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Display the master summary table
print(master_summary_table)
```
